periods.summary: Or-Gaule contacts Naseem after the League border massacre, praises his victory over Carlo, and explains that the League army is effectively neutralized, though Naseem warns him not to interrupt his fight with Nene. At the start of the war Or-Gaule lets the battle split into personal duels. He confronts Alice by staging puppet reenactments of the Bloody Cross victims, including a doll resembling Alice herself begging him to stop. He enjoys Alice's rage and frames their fight as a continuation of the original massacre. In combat, Or-Gaule relies on invisible Black Widow threads spread through Luxel to create aerial footholds, evade Alice's stronger body, launch Killing Opera thread slashes, and hurl buildings with Deus Ex Machina. He also constantly talks about the murdered villagers with apparent affection, wounding Alice psychologically. After luring her through his thread nest, he attempts Marionette, but Alice's destiny-level fixation on killing him prevents control. His attacks cannot penetrate Invincible Armor, so he uses threads around her neck that tighten with her own movement. Even this only slows her: Alice throws her axe, predicts his escape, crushes both hands, and nearly strangles him. He escapes by manipulating threads with his toes after Alice spasms from suffocation, but Stella intercepts him in the sky and declares him one of the people better dead before releasing Salamander flame.

key_events.summary: Speaks with Naseem after the League army's defeat and confirms outside interference is reduced.
Tries to recreate Alice's trauma but is physically overwhelmed.
Attempts to flee upward only to be blocked by Stella's dragon fire.
